Chat Edit: 'Add a command to run benchmarking on faiss with the command

"/users/zimooo2/big-ann-benchmarks/.venv/bin/python3 /users/zimooo2/big-ann-benchmarks/data/10M_benc
hmark.py --threads 16 --index-key HNSW,Flat --stress-mode latency --dataset openai"

to all of the benhcmarking scripts

There is an example of calling run_command with faiss in the legging.sh script'

Chat Edit: 'Apply the sysfs writing that happens in hybridtier to the settings in measurement_arms

    write_sysfs_value /proc/sys/vm/zone_reclaim_mode 0
    write_sysfs_value /proc/sys/kernel/numa_balancing 0
    write_sysfs_value /sys/kernel/mm/numa/demotion_enabled 0
    write_sysfs_value /proc/sys/vm/watermark_scale_factor 10
    write_sysfs_value /sys/kernel/mm/lru_gen/enabled 0x0000'
Chat Edit: 'Move these changes to setup.sh and then remove them from measurement_hybridtier.sh'
Chat Edit: 'One of these fixes is making it such that the time files are not in a subfolder for the workload (at least for arms). Please look at all the scripts and fix this'
Chat Edit: 'One of these fixes is making it such that the time files are not in a subfolder for the workload (at least for arms). Please look at all the scripts and fix this'

Chat Edit: 'Can you make it so that if any workload command takes longer than 45 minutes, it times out and repots this somehow in the time. Also once the run_all_measurements script finishes, I want it to send me an email with how long it took'

Chat Edit: 'I want to track the L3 miss rate if we are running the local arms dram train script. This is true when #sym:NEAR_MEM_TRACING_RUN  is true. We already track the L3 store misses through pebs counters. Please also track MEM_INST_RETIRED.ALL_LOADS and then store the results in a lot file.'
Chat Edit: 'please add the copy to measurement _arms'
